components.name: Claude app demo
components.summary: A slash command typed into the Claude app, then the finished clip as the reply.
components.use: showing how you made it, skill demos

components.name: Write this, get this
components.summary: The prompt types in, sends, and the finished clip grows up to fill the frame.
components.use: hooks for tutorials, before and after

components.name: Talking head
components.summary: Full-frame face with a barely-there drift between cuts.

components.name: Punch-in
components.summary: Hard cut to a 1.2× zoom on a phrase start. Nothing else changes.

components.name: Full-screen clip
components.summary: B-roll or a screen recording takes the whole frame; captions stay.

components.name: Split screen
components.summary: Dark page with the graphic on top, you filling the bottom, a black caption chip on the seam.

components.name: Video grid
components.summary: Four clips play at once in a 2×2 grid, each one coming into focus.

components.name: Clip wall behind you
components.summary: The room behind you swaps for a wall of playing clips; you stay cut out on top.

components.name: Landscape clip
components.summary: A landscape clip plays in a card over a blurred copy of itself.
components.use: wide B-roll or a desktop screen recording

components.name: Clip over you
components.summary: The clip plays in the top half while you talk in the bottom half.

components.name: Screen zoom
components.summary: A screen recording pushes in, a red box marks the spot, then it cuts to a zoom.
components.use: pointing at one thing on screen

components.name: Subtitle
components.summary: A clean sentence-case line low in the frame, like proper subtitles.

components.name: Plain
components.summary: Big white words with a soft shadow, one or two at a time, centred. No box, no font swap.

components.name: Bold
components.summary: Big white words, one or two at a time, centred. Key phrases switch to an italic serif.
components.use: talking reels with emphasis on key phrases

components.name: Box
components.summary: Bold words, and the one being said sits on an accent-coloured box.

components.name: Pop
components.summary: Heavy uppercase words with a black outline. The word being said turns yellow.

components.name: Mono
components.summary: Small uppercase monospace, up to three words, on a dark pill over seams.

components.name: Step header
components.summary: An accent Step tag with the step title typing on beside it.

components.name: Hook card
components.summary: The opening title in big narrow caps with one serif italic word.

components.name: Prompt card
components.summary: A Claude prompt typing in with the file attached, then send.
components.use: what you asked Claude to do

components.name: Checklist
components.summary: Rows tick one after another in the accent colour.

components.name: View counter
components.summary: A huge view count climbing with an accent bar filling under it.

components.name: Folder
components.summary: A project folder with files sliding in on a tree line.

components.name: Numbered list
components.summary: Numbered rows that light up as you say them.

components.name: Bar chart
components.summary: Bars grow in with their numbers, the top one in the accent colour.

components.name: Compare row
components.summary: Three thumbnails labelled bad, good, best with view pills.

components.name: Comment end card
components.summary: Comment KEYWORD, huge, with one line on what they get.

components.name: Slow push
components.summary: The whole scene pushes in slowly so nothing ever sits frozen.

components.name: Floating clip
components.summary: A clip pops in over you in a white-edged card with a source tag.
components.use: reacting to or citing a video

components.name: Clip fan
components.summary: Three clips fan out at once in tilted cards.

components.name: Clips around you
components.summary: Clips float at different depths around you, some behind and some in front.

components.name: Clips fly out
components.summary: Clip cards fly out from behind your head and hang at the sides.

components.name: Chat app
components.summary: A chat with an assistant: the prompt types, sends, and the reply streams in.
components.use: showing what you asked an AI and what it said

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: A coding agent in a terminal: a command types, files change, a tick when it's done.
components.use: showing an agent doing the work

components.name: Notes
components.summary: A notes page writing itself line by line.

components.name: Text messages
components.summary: A text thread with typing dots and bubbles popping in.
components.use: a conversation, a reaction, a question someone asked

components.name: Social post
components.summary: A post card with its replies, reposts and likes counting up.
components.use: a quote, a take, proof something landed

components.name: Analytics
components.summary: An analytics screen: the total counts up and the line draws in.

components.name: Inbox
components.summary: Emails arriving one after another at the top of an inbox.
components.use: deals, replies, things landing in your inbox

components.name: Browser
components.summary: A web page that scrolls, then one line gets highlighted.
components.use: citing an article, a source, a quote from a page
